title: Review the parallel-jobs design and record findings (RM-0)
summary: Write an independent review of docs/design/parallel-jobs.md as docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-1.md, as build-plan item 1 specifies. It reads the cited code to decide the seven open questions. It also weighs today's evidence: parallel branches collided on CHANGELOG.md and on D81 numbering, and hand-merged squashes are refused. The review then marks the design's status as reviewed.

defaults_applied.how: Each review claim cites the file and lines read, or is labeled unchecked or an estimate.
The review is written so an outside reader can follow it without session context.
One review file and a minimal status update to the design.
The review path, scope and open questions are taken from section 10 and 11 of the design.
No emails, secrets or personal data appear in the review.
A verifier checks the review's citations against the source.

assumptions: 'Independently' means a fresh reviewer reading the design and the cited source, not the design's author.
The review file path is the one the design names in section 10 item 1.
The review decides the open questions but builds nothing; implementation stays out of scope.
Today's collisions are evidence for the review (shared append-only files, stale candidates), not a request to change the landing code.
The review also updates the design's status and adds a response section, as section 10 says.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-1.md exists, is written for an outside reader, and gives a verdict (accept, accept with changes, or reject) for the design.
The review answers each of the seven open questions in section 11 with a decision. Each cites the file and lines it read, or labels the claim as unchecked.

The review checks the design's (read) claims against the cited source: locks in state.rs, run.rs land_or_block, plan in land.rs, and manage.rs and commits.rs lock order. It reports any claim that does not hold.

The review addresses today's evidence. Parallel branches that each edit CHANGELOG.md and take the next number in docs/decisions.md (both D81) will always conflict. The landing check refuses a hand-merged squash, so a stale candidate needs re-verification. The review says whether the design handles this: section 7 treats it as stale, and the docs job in section 10 is the shared-file hotspot. It recommends a concrete change or marks the gap as a finding.
The review lists findings with severity, and says which can be fixed in the design and which belong to later jobs.

docs/design/parallel-jobs.md has its pending-review status and the build-plan item 1 updated to point to the review, and has a short response to the review added. Nothing else in the design changes without a stated reason.
No file outside docs/ changes. records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml and CI files are untouched. No secrets or personal data appear.

out_of_scope: Changing land.rs, run.rs or the landing check
Adding README, CHANGELOG or docs/decisions.md entries
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, CI or any governance file
departures: Cost and time are raised a little over the reference: the review must read several source files (run.rs, land.rs, state.rs, manage.rs, commits.rs) to check the design's claims.
